sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. This is a strong opportunity for the leaders, as Alsager sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches. Sandbach come into the fixture off the back of a loss but remain unbeaten in their five games before that, showing resilience and consistency.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tricky away fixture at Dawley Town; both sides have recent losses on their record and will be looking to bounce back. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting of two in-form sides—Bridgnorth have won three of their last four, while Eccleshall have recovered from losses with a recent win. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a clash between two mid-table sides looking to build momentum. Foley Meir face Bilston Town, with Bilston in strong form after three consecutive wins. Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills in a contest between two struggling sides seeking consistency. Shawbury United host Barnton, where Shawbury's alarming run of five consecutive losses desperately needs reversing. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town, a bottom-half clash with both sides seeking their first runs of decent form. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, where bottom club Widnes have taken just 2 points from seven games. Crewe play at home to Allscott Heath in a match between two teams fighting to climb away from the lower reaches of the table.
